study_purpose.text: This study aims to understand what features families want in a web-based program for communicating health information and to test a new website designed to teach new ways of communicating about Lynch Syndrome.

who_may_join.text: Eligible participants are those who are affected by Lynch syndrome and are willing to provide feedback on a web-based program or use a new website designed to teach about Lynch Syndrome.

procedures_or_participation.text: Participants will be asked about their preferences for a web-based program, complete questionnaires, and use a new website designed to teach about Lynch Syndrome. They will also provide feedback on the website.

risks_or_burdens.text: There are no specific risks mentioned. Participants may spend time filling out questionnaires and using the website.

time_commitment.text: The time commitment varies depending on the group. It takes about 1 hour for Group 1, 90 minutes for Group 2, and 1 hour for Group 3.
